# `adt checkout`

Download ABAP objects to abapgit-compatible local files

```bash
adt checkout [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command                      | Description                                                           |
| ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `adt checkout class`         | Download class to abapgit-compatible local files                      |
| `adt checkout interface`     | Download interface to abapgit-compatible local files                  |
| `adt checkout program`       | Download program to abapgit-compatible local files                    |
| `adt checkout domain`        | Download domain to abapgit-compatible local files                     |
| `adt checkout dataelement`   | Download dataelement to abapgit-compatible local files                |
| `adt checkout table`         | Download table to abapgit-compatible local files                      |
| `adt checkout functiongroup` | Download functiongroup to abapgit-compatible local files              |
| `adt checkout ddl`           | Download ddl to abapgit-compatible local files                        |
| `adt checkout dcl`           | Download dcl to abapgit-compatible local files                        |
| `adt checkout package`       | Download a package and its contents to abapgit-compatible local files |

## `adt checkout class`

Download class to abapgit-compatible local files

```bash
adt checkout class [options] <name> [targetFolder]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument         | Description          | Default |
| ---------------- | -------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>`         | class name           |         |
| `[targetFolder]` | Target output folder | `.`     |

**Options**

| Option                | Description                               | Default   |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `-o, --output <path>` | Output directory (overrides targetFolder) |           |
| `--format <format>`   | Output format (default: abapgit)          | `abapgit` |
| `--debug`             | Enable debug output                       | `false`   |

## `adt checkout package`

Download a package and its contents to abapgit-compatible local files

```bash
adt checkout package [options] <packageName> [targetFolder]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument         | Description          | Default |
| ---------------- | -------------------- | ------- |
| `<packageName>`  | ABAP package name    |         |
| `[targetFolder]` | Target output folder | `.`     |

**Options**

| Option                       | Description                                         | Default   |
| ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `-o, --output <path>`        | Output directory (overrides targetFolder)           |           |
| `-t, --object-types <types>` | Comma-separated object types (e.g., CLAS,INTF,DDLS) |           |
| `--no-sub-packages`          | Exclude subpackages                                 |           |
| `--format <format>`          | Output format (default: abapgit)                    | `abapgit` |
| `--debug`                    | Enable debug output                                 | `false`   |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
